description: Backend foundation: package scaffold, config (feature switches), SQLAlchemy DB + all ORM models (relational temporal edges), JWT auth with roles, basic logging, app factory, and auth API. This is the environment-setup + core-platform feature; it establishes the venv, requirements, and a green pytest baseline. Corresponds to tasks.md T1.
steps: Create backend/requirements.txt with: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], sqlalchemy>=2, psycopg2-binary, pydantic, pydantic-settings, python-jose[cryptography], passlib[bcrypt], python-multipart, pypdf, pillow, pytesseract, python-dateutil, scikit-learn, numpy, web3, pytest, httpx. Create backend/pyproject.toml (or setup.cfg) so 'finalsay' is an importable package. Create the venv with ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m venv backend/.venv and install requirements.

Implement finalsay/config.py using pydantic-settings Settings with env prefix FINALSAY_ per design.md section 2: database_url (default sqlite:///./finalsay.db), comparison_model (default mock), hf_model_name, anchor (default local), confidence_threshold (default 0.6), jwt_secret (dev default), polygon_* (unset), tesseract_cmd (auto). Support a .env file.
Implement finalsay/db.py: SQLAlchemy 2.x engine + SessionLocal + Base + get_db dependency; connect_args for sqlite check_same_thread=False.

Implement finalsay/models.py with ALL models from design.md section 3: institution, user (role in student/reviewer/admin/issuer), notice (kind official/submission; fields issuer,notice_date,deadline,audience,action,redacted_text,source_url,retrieved_at,sha256), notice_field, relation_edge (src/dst notice, label, confidence, rationale, model, status auto/unresolved/confirmed/corrected), merkle_root, merkle_proof, anchor_block, review_case, benchmark_pair, benchmark_annotation. Add the indexes listed in design section 3.
Implement finalsay/schemas.py with base Pydantic v2 request/response models used by auth and shared types.
Implement finalsay/auth.py: bcrypt hashing (passlib), JWT HS256 issue/verify (python-jose), get_current_user dependency, require_role(*roles) dependency returning 403 on mismatch.

Implement finalsay/logging_conf.py (basic logging config) and finalsay/main.py app factory: create_app() that sets up logging, a request-logging middleware, includes routers, creates tables on startup for sqlite, and exposes GET /api/health returning {status:ok}. Wire api/auth.py router (register, login returning JWT, me).

Add backend/finalsay/tests/conftest.py providing a TestClient against a temp SQLite DB (in-process; do NOT rely on a persistent server), and backend/finalsay/tests/test_auth.py covering register -> login -> me success and a require_role 403 path.
acceptance_criteria: backend/.venv/bin/python -c 'from finalsay.main import create_app; create_app()' works (run with cwd backend or PYTHONPATH=backend)
All ORM models from design section 3 exist and create_all succeeds on SQLite
findings: Implemented the full backend scaffold under /projects/sandbox/backend. Created requirements.txt, pyproject.toml (package 'finalsay' importable), and the venv at backend/.venv using Python 3.11.15 via pyenv; installed all requirements. Files: config.py (pydantic-settings Settings, FINALSAY_ prefix, .env support, all design section-2 switches with documented defaults incl. sqlite default, mock model, local anchor, confidence_threshold 0.6, dev jwt_secret; get_settings() cached), db.py (SQLAlchemy 2.x DeclarativeBase, engine with sqlite check_same_thread=False connect_args, SessionLocal, get_db dependency), models.py (ALL design section-3 models: Institution, User, Notice, NoticeField, RelationEdge [temporal relation as relational edge], MerkleRoot, MerkleProof, AnchorBlock, ReviewCase, BenchmarkPair, BenchmarkAnnotation; string enums exported as RELATIONSHIP_LABELS/USER_ROLES/NOTICE_KINDS/EDGE_STATUSES; indexes on notice.institution_id, notice.kind, relation_edge.status, merkle_proof.notice_id), schemas.py (Pydantic v2 Health/Auth models), auth.py (passlib bcrypt hashing, python-jose HS256 issue/verify, get_current_user, require_role(*roles) -> 403, authenticate_user), logging_conf.py (basic logging, configure once), main.py (create_app factory: logging + request-logging middleware + create_all on startup + GET /api/health {status:ok} + api/auth router), api/auth.py (register [409 on dup, 422 on bad role], login OAuth2 password flow returning JWT, me). Tests: conftest.py sets FINALSAY_DATABASE_URL to a temp SQLite DB under the backend tree (NOT /tmp) before import, per-test fresh schema, TestClient with get_db override, atexit cleanup; test_auth.py covers health, register->login->me, duplicate 409, wrong password 401, unauthenticated /me 401, and require_role 403-vs-200. Verification: `import finalsay.models,finalsay.config,finalsay.auth,finalsay.db` ok; `from finalsay.main import create_app; create_app()` ok; `pytest finalsay/tests` = 6 passed. NOTE/DEVIATION: added email-validator (required by Pydantic EmailStr) and pinned bcrypt<4.1 (installed 4.0.1) to requirements.txt because bcrypt 5.0.0 is incompatible with passlib 1.7.4's backend detection; without the pin password hashing errors out. Added /projects/sandbox/.gitignore to exclude venv, *.db, temp test dirs, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, node_modules. No git repo yet (orchestrator publishes later), so no commit was made.
